sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Choose the correct preposition: The hikers climbed ____ the steep hill during their journey.
Identify the correct adjective of comparison: The team captain is the ____ player on the field.
When a child flies high up in a swing, what do they usually see over the wall?
Choose the correct tense to complete the sentence: Tomorrow, our school team ____ the championship match.
Fill in the blank with the correct conjunction: The students were very tired, ____ they refused to give up the game.
What does the idiom 'once in a blue moon' mean?
Choose the correct adverb for the sentence: The children cheered ____ when they won the tournament.
Which of these is the most important habit for maintaining a fit body and a fit mind?
options: B) Sleeping for only three hours
C) Regular exercise and healthy eating
questions.answer: C) Regular exercise and healthy eating

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the suitable preposition: The ancient stone fort is situated ____ the banks of the holy river.
Identify the tense of this sentence: The players had finished their warm-up before the coach arrived.

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: Why is it important to balance a nutritious diet with regular physical activities? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Balancing a nutritious diet with daily physical activities keeps our muscles strong and our brains active. This helps us study better and stay perfectly healthy.

questions.question_text: Combine these two sentences using a suitable conjunction showing reason: 'She missed the school bus. She woke up very late.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: She missed the school bus because she woke up very late. The conjunction 'because' properly links the result to its specific cause in the sentence.

questions.question_text: What teamwork skills are necessary to win a fast-paced traditional game like Lagori? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To become champions, players need excellent communication, quick reflexes, and strong coordination. They must protect each other and rebuild the stone pile together rapidly.

questions.question_text: Change the given sentence into the Future Continuous Tense: 'The children play in the garden.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The correct future continuous tense is: 'The children will be playing in the garden.' This shows an action that will continue at a later time.

questions.question_text: Make a meaningful sentence using the idiom 'a piece of cake'. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Because I had studied all the grammar rules thoroughly, the final English examination was a piece of cake for me and I finished it early.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are trekking in a magical, snowy mountain range. Describe the sights and sounds you experience around you. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Standing at the snowy peak of the mountains, I can see fluffy white clouds floating below me. The cold wind howls loudly through the tall pine trees, and I can hear the peaceful sound of a distant waterfall echoing across the green valley.

questions.question_text: Compare a modern busy city with a peaceful historical town using at least two adjectives of comparison and one adverb. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: A modern city is usually noisier and more crowded than a peaceful historical town. However, an ancient town boasts much older and more beautiful architecture. The local river flows gently along the stone ghats, making it a calmly historic place to visit.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Formal Writing

questions.question_text: Write a formal letter to your school principal requesting permission to organize a 'Sports and Fitness Week' for the students. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Respected Principal, I request your permission to organize a 'Sports and Fitness Week' in our school next month. Regular exercise is essential for students' physical and mental health. This event will encourage everyone to participate in outdoor games and adopt healthier habits. Kindly approve our proposal. Thanking you, Yours obediently.

questions.question_text: Write a descriptive paragraph about how a child feels while swinging high up in the air, imagining the wind and the view. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: When a child swings high up in the air, they feel incredibly free and joyful, as if they are flying like a bird. The cool wind rushes past their face, and they can see over the garden walls to the green rivers and trees. It is the most thrilling feeling.
